aggregation.error: any incomplete or ambiguous population/read/parse state yields ERROR; no partial PASS

binary_safety.reason: Bash variables cannot preserve NUL and trailing CR can be silently absorbed into fields, so malformed bytes must be rejected before mapfile parsing.
binary_safety.rule: Raw /etc/passwd and /etc/shadow bytes are validated before Bash line parsing. NUL or any CR byte yields ERROR; only LF line termination is admitted.

error_value_contract: Every ERROR wire value is a stable <domain>:<reason> code; literal - is reserved for non-error absence such as NOT_FOUND.

malformed_or_duplicate_behavior.raw_byte_validation: NUL or CR in either population/state source => ERROR before line parsing.

password_state_rule: the second field of the matching /etc/shadow record must be non-empty; non-empty lock markers, hashes and other non-empty crypt-field representations satisfy the source criterion that the field is not empty
population_rule: each syntactically valid unique /etc/passwd username must have exactly one syntactically valid /etc/shadow record
source_scope: local Linux user accounts whose account population is represented by /etc/passwd and password/lock state by /etc/shadow
